osm_sqls.query: create table if not exists bounds as select min (t1.lat) as min_lat, max(t1.lat) as max_lat, min(t1.lon) as min_lon, max(t1.lon) as max_lon from way_street_node_data t1

select id, distance_nm from ( select distinct t2.id, mx_calc_distance( ?1, ?2, t1.lat, t1.lon, 3440) as distance_nm from way_street_node_data t1, way_tag_data t2 where t2.key_attrib = 'highway' and t2.val_attrib in('primary', 'secondary', 'tertiary', 'residential', 'service', 'living_street', 'track') and t1.id = t2.id and t1.lat between ?3 and ?4 and t1.lon between ?5 and ?6 ) where distance_nm between ?7 and ?8
select t2.id, t2.key_attrib, t2.val_attrib from way_tag_data t2 where t2.id = ?1
select t1.lat, t1.lon from way_street_node_data t1 where t1.id = ?1 order by t1.node_id

select min_lat, max_lat, min_lon, max_lon, case when min_lat <= ?1 then 1 else 0 end as min_lat_test, case when max_lat >= ?2 then 1 else 0 end as max_lat_test, case when min_lon <= ?3 then 1 else 0 end as min_lon_test, case when max_lon >= ?4 then 1 else 0 end as max_lon_test from bounds limit 1

select id, distance_nm from ( select distinct wtd.id, mx_calc_distance( ?1, ?2, wsnd.lat, wsnd.lon, 3440) as distance_nm from way_street_node_data wsnd, way_tag_data wtd where 1 = 1 and wsnd.id = wtd.id and wsnd.lat between ?3 and ?4 and wsnd.lon between ?5 and ?6

oilrig_sqls.query: with oilrigs_vu as ( select oilRigVu.icao_id, oilRigVu.icao, oilRigVu.ap_name, oilRigVu.ap_lat, oilRigVu.ap_lon, trunc(oilRigVu.ap_lat) as ap_lat_trunc, trunc(oilRigVu.ap_lon) as ap_lon_trunc from airports_vu oilRigVu where oilRigVu.is_oilrig > 0 {} ), airports_with_helipads_vu as ( select av.icao_id, av.icao, av.ap_name, av.ap_lat, av.ap_lon, trunc(av.ap_lat) as ap_lat_trunc, trunc(av.ap_lon) as ap_lon_trunc from airports_vu av where av.is_oilrig = 0 -- and av.ramp_helos + av.helipads > 0 ) select mx_calc_distance(ov.ap_lat, ov.ap_lon, awh.ap_lat , awh.ap_lon, 3440) as distance , ov.icao_id as oilrig_icao_id, ov.icao as oilrig_icao, ov.ap_name as oilrig_name, ov.ap_lat as oilrig_lat, ov.ap_lon as oilrig_lon , awh.icao_id as start_icao_id, awh.icao as start_icao, awh.ap_name as start_ap_name, awh.ap_lat as start_lat, awh.ap_lon as start_lon from oilrigs_vu ov, airports_with_helipads_vu awh where 1 = 1 and ov.icao_id != awh.icao_id and ( awh.ap_lat between ov.ap_lat_trunc - 2 and ov.ap_lat_trunc + 2 and awh.ap_lon between ov.ap_lon_trunc - 2 and ov.ap_lon_trunc + 2 ) order by RANDOM() limit 1

navdata_sqls.query: select t1.icao_id , FORMAT("%s (%s), coord: %3.4f/%3.4f (%ift) ", t1.ap_name, t1.icao, ap_lat, ap_lon, ap_elev) as data , mx_calc_distance(t1.ap_lat, t1.ap_lon, {}, {}, 3440) as distance, t1.ap_lat, t1.ap_lon from xp_airports t1 where 1 = 1 and icao = '{}' order by distance

select t2.rw_no_1 || '/' || t2.rw_no_2 as rw_key , FORMAT ("%-*s Length: %d meters", 10, t2.rw_no_1 || '/' || t2.rw_no_2, t2.rw_length_mt) as rw_data , mx_calc_distance(t2.rw_no_1_lat, t2.rw_no_1_lon, {}, {}, 3440) as distance from xp_rw t2 where 1 = 1 and icao_id = '{}'

WITH vor_dme AS ( SELECT v1.ident, v1.loc_data, distance, 'VOR/DME' AS loc_type, v1.frq_mhz, identNameFrq, prevIdentNameFrq FROM ( SELECT t3.ident, FORMAT("%.2f (%i,%s) %s", CASE WHEN length(t3.frq_mhz) = 5 THEN t3.frq_mhz / 100.0 ELSE t3.frq_mhz END , mx_bearing({1}, {2}, t3.lat, t3.lon) , 'VOR/DME'/* constant */ , t3.name) AS loc_data, mx_calc_distance(t3.lat, t3.lon, {3}, {4}, 3440) AS distance, t3.loc_type, t3.frq_mhz, IFNULL( (t3.ident || t3.name || t3.frq_mhz), t3.ident) AS identNameFrq, lag(IFNULL( (t3.ident || t3.name || t3.frq_mhz), t3.ident)) OVER (ORDER BY t3.ident, t3.frq_mhz, t3.loc_type) AS prevIdentNameFrq, lag(t3.loc_type) OVER (ORDER BY ident, frq_mhz, loc_type) AS prev_type FROM xp_loc t3 WHERE distance <= 20 and t3.loc_type in ('VOR', 'DME') ORDER BY distance, ident, frq_mhz, name ) v1 WHERE 1 = 1 AND v1.identNameFrq = v1.prevIdentNameFrq AND ( (v1.loc_type = 'VOR' AND v1.prev_type = 'DME') OR (v1.loc_type = 'DME' AND v1.prev_type = 'VOR') ) ) SELECT v1.ident, v1.loc_data, v1.distance FROM vor_dme v1 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ( SELECT t1.ident , FORMAT("%.2f (%i,%s) %s", CASE WHEN length(t1.frq_mhz) = 5 THEN t1.frq_mhz / 100.0 ELSE t1.frq_mhz END, mx_bearing({5}, {6}, t1.lat, t1.lon), t1.loc_type, t1.name) AS loc_data , mx_calc_distance(t1.lat, t1.lon, {7}, {8}, 3440) as distance FROM xp_loc t1 WHERE mx_calc_distance (t1.lat, t1.lon, {9}, {10}, 3440) <= 20 AND t1.loc_type IN ('VOR', 'DME') AND IFNULL( (t1.ident || t1.name || t1.frq_mhz), t1.ident) not in (select identNameFrq from vor_dme) UNION ALL SELECT t1.ident, FORMAT("%i (%i,%s) %s", t1.frq_mhz , mx_bearing({11}, {12}, t1.lat, t1.lon) , t1.loc_type , t1.name) AS loc_data , mx_calc_distance(t1.lat, t1.lon, {13}, {14}, 3440) as distance FROM xp_loc t1 WHERE mx_calc_distance(t1.lat, t1.lon, {15}, {16}, 3440) <= 20 AND t1.loc_type = 'NDB' ORDER BY distance )

select loc_data, distance, loc_type_code, loc_rw from ( select FORMAT ("%-*s , freq: %5.3f, Type: %s, Region: %-*s, lat/lon: %3.0f/%3.0f ", 4, t3.loc_rw, t3.frq_mhz*0.01, t3.loc_type, 3, icao_region_code, t3.lat, t3.lon ) as loc_data , mx_calc_distance(t3.lat, t3.lon, {1}, {2}, 3440) as distance , t3.loc_rw , 1 as loc_type_code from xp_loc t3 where icao = '{3}' and ( t3.loc_type like ('ILS%' ) or t3.loc_type like ('LOC%' ) ) ) v1 UNION ALL select loc_data, distance, loc_type_code, loc_rw from ( select FORMAT ("%-*s , channel: %i/%s, Type: %s, Region: %-*s, lat/lon: %3.0f/%3.0f ", 4, t3.loc_rw, t3.frq_mhz, t3.ident, t3.loc_type, 3, icao_region_code, t3.lat, t3.lon ) as loc_data , mx_calc_distance(t3.lat, t3.lon, {4}, {5}, 3440) as distance , t3.loc_rw , 2 as loc_type_code from xp_loc t3 where icao = '{6}' and t3.loc_type not like ('ILS%' ) and t3.loc_type not like ('LOC%' ) and t3.loc_type not in ('DME', 'VOR', 'NDB' ) ) order by loc_type_code, loc_rw

ils_sqls.query: select icao, round(distance_nm) as distance_nm, loc_rw, loc_type, frq_mhz, loc_bearing, rw_length_mt, rw_width, ap_elev, ap_name, surf_type_text, bearing_from_to_icao from ( select xp_loc.icao , mx_calc_distance ({1}, {2}, xp_loc.lat, xp_loc.lon, 3440) as distance_nm , xp_loc.loc_rw, xp_loc.loc_type, xp_loc.frq_mhz, xp_loc.loc_bearing, xp_rw.rw_length_mt, xp_rw.rw_width, xa.ap_elev, xa.ap_name , case xp_rw.rw_surf when 1 then 'Asphalt' when 2 then 'Concrete' when 3 then 'Turf or grass' when 4 then 'Dirt' when 5 then 'Gravel' when 12 then 'Dry lakebed' when 13 then 'Water runways' when 14 then 'Snow or ice' when 15 then 'Transparent' else 'other' end as surf_type_text , mx_bearing({3}, {4}, xp_loc.lat, xp_loc.lon) as bearing_from_to_icao from xp_loc, xp_rw, xp_airports xa where xp_rw.icao = xp_loc.icao and (xp_rw.rw_no_1 = xp_loc.loc_rw or xp_rw.rw_no_2 = xp_loc.loc_rw) and xa.icao = xp_rw.icao ) where 1 = 1

select icao, round(distance_nm) as distance_nm, '' as loc_rw, '' as loc_type, 0 as frq_mhz, 0 as loc_bearing, rw_length_mt, rw_width, ap_elev, ap_name, surf_type_text, bearing_from_to_icao from ( select xa.icao , mx_calc_distance ({}, {}, xa.ap_lat, xa.ap_lon, 3440) as distance_nm , xp_rw.rw_length_mt, xp_rw.rw_width, xa.ap_elev, xa.ap_name , case xp_rw.rw_surf when 1 then 'Asphalt' when 2 then 'Concrete' when 3 then 'Turf or grass' when 4 then 'Dirt' when 5 then 'Gravel' when 12 then 'Dry lakebed' when 13 then 'Water runways' when 14 then 'Snow or ice' when 15 then 'Transparent' else 'no data' end as surf_type_text , mx_bearing({}, {}, xa.ap_lat, xa.ap_lon) as bearing_from_to_icao from xp_rw, xp_airports xa, airports_vu avu where 1 = 1 and xa.icao_id = xp_rw.icao_id and xa.icao_id = avu.icao_id and avu.ap_type = 1 -- 1 = airports, 16=sealane, 17=heliports ) where 1 = 1

osm_db2_sqls.query: select (select count(*) from sqlite_master where type = 'table' and name in ('meta', 'bounds', 'way_class', 'ways', 'ways_rtree', 'trails', 'trails_rtree', 'piste_type', 'piste_difficulty', 'places')) = 10 and exists (select 1 from pragma_table_xinfo('ways') where name = 'label') and exists (select 1 from pragma_table_xinfo('trails') where name = 'piste') and exists (select 1 from pragma_table_xinfo('places') where name = 'emergency_room') as is_valid , (select value from meta where key = 'schema_version') as schema_version

select count(*) as bounds_rows , ifnull(sum(case when b.max_lat >= ?1 and b.min_lat <= ?2 and b.max_lon >= ?3 and b.min_lon <= ?4 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as overlapping_rows , min(b.min_lat) as min_lat, max(b.max_lat) as max_lat, min(b.min_lon) as min_lon, max(b.max_lon) as max_lon from bounds b

with picked as materialized ( -- one random road in the area with at least one vertex in the distance range, and one random vertex of it ("lat,lon,bearing") select v.* , mx_way_pick_node(v.geom, v.nodes, ?1, ?2, ?7, ?8) as picked_node from ( select w.id, w.label, w.name, w.ref, c.name as class_name, w.surface, w.length_m , w.nodes, w.geom , mx_calc_distance(?1, ?2, w.clat, w.clon, 3440) as distance_nm from ways_rtree r join ways w on w.id = r.id join way_class c on c.id = w.class where r.max_lat >= cast(round(?3 * 1e7) as int) and r.min_lat <= cast(round(?4 * 1e7) as int) and r.max_lon >= cast(round(?5 * 1e7) as int) and r.min_lon <= cast(round(?6 * 1e7) as int) {designer_filter} and mx_way_node_in_range(w.geom, w.nodes, ?1, ?2, ?7, ?8) = 1 order by random() limit 1 ) v ), coords as ( -- split "lat,lon,bearing" into numbers select p.* , cast(substr(p.picked_node, 1, instr(p.picked_node, ',') - 1) as real) as picked_lat , cast(substr(p.rest, 1, instr(p.rest, ',') - 1) as real) as picked_lon , cast(substr(p.rest, instr(p.rest, ',') + 1) as real) as picked_bearing from (select picked.*, substr(picked.picked_node, instr(picked.picked_node, ',') + 1) as rest from picked) p ) select k.id, k.label, k.name, k.ref, k.class_name, k.surface, k.length_m, k.distance_nm , k.picked_lat, k.picked_lon, k.picked_bearing -- name to display: label (name and ref), then name, then the coordinate , coalesce(nullif(k.label, ''), nullif(k.name, ''), printf('osmdb coordinate (%.5f/%.5f)', k.picked_lat, k.picked_lon)) as display_name -- description, example: residential (asphalt) , k.class_name || coalesce(' (' || nullif(k.surface, '') || ')', '') as display_desc from coords k

with picked as materialized ( -- one random trail or piste in the area with at least one vertex in the distance range, and one random vertex of it ("lat,lon,bearing") select v.* , mx_way_pick_node(v.geom, v.nodes, ?1, ?2, ?7, ?8) as picked_node from ( select t.id, t.label, t.name, t.ref, c.name as class_name, t.surface, t.sac_scale, t.mtb_scale, t.bicycle, t.foot, t.length_m , t.piste, pt.name as piste_type_name, pd.name as piste_difficulty_name , t.nodes, t.geom , mx_calc_distance(?1, ?2, t.clat, t.clon, 3440) as distance_nm from trails_rtree r join trails t on t.id = r.id join way_class c on c.id = t.class left join piste_type pt on pt.id = t.piste_type left join piste_difficulty pd on pd.id = t.piste_difficulty where r.max_lat >= cast(round(?3 * 1e7) as int) and r.min_lat <= cast(round(?4 * 1e7) as int) and r.max_lon >= cast(round(?5 * 1e7) as int) and r.min_lon <= cast(round(?6 * 1e7) as int) {designer_filter} and mx_way_node_in_range(t.geom, t.nodes, ?1, ?2, ?7, ?8) = 1 order by random() limit 1 ) v ), coords as ( -- split "lat,lon,bearing" into numbers select p.* , cast(substr(p.picked_node, 1, instr(p.picked_node, ',') - 1) as real) as picked_lat , cast(substr(p.rest, 1, instr(p.rest, ',') - 1) as real) as picked_lon , cast(substr(p.rest, instr(p.rest, ',') + 1) as real) as picked_bearing from (select picked.*, substr(picked.picked_node, instr(picked.picked_node, ',') + 1) as rest from picked) p ) select k.id, k.label, k.name, k.ref, k.class_name, k.surface, k.sac_scale, k.mtb_scale, k.bicycle, k.foot, k.length_m , k.piste, k.piste_type_name, k.piste_difficulty_name, k.distance_nm , k.picked_lat, k.picked_lon, k.picked_bearing -- name to display: label (name and ref), then name, then the coordinate , coalesce(nullif(k.label, ''), nullif(k.name, ''), printf('osmdb coordinate (%.5f/%.5f)', k.picked_lat, k.picked_lon)) as display_name -- description, examples: path (mountain_hiking, gravel, mtb scale 2) / ski piste downhill (intermediate) , case when k.piste then 'ski piste' || coalesce(' ' || nullif(k.piste_type_name, ''), '') else k.class_name end || case when k.details <> '' then ' (' || k.details || ')' else '' end as display_desc from ( select coords.* , case when coords.piste then coalesce(nullif(coords.piste_difficulty_name, ''), '') else ltrim(coalesce(', ' || nullif(coords.sac_scale, ''), '') || coalesce(', ' || nullif(coords.surface, ''), '') || coalesce(', mtb scale ' || nullif(coords.mtb_scale, ''), ''), ', ') end as details from coords ) k

select p.id, p.kind, p.name, p.name_en, p.icao, p.faa, p.iata, p.ref, p.address, p.emergency_room, p.helipad_near, p.lat, p.lon , mx_calc_distance(?1, ?2, p.lat, p.lon, 3440) as distance_nm -- ICAO-like id: icao, then faa, then iata , coalesce(nullif(p.icao, ''), nullif(p.faa, ''), nullif(p.iata, '')) as display_id -- name to display: name, name_en, kind + ref (helipad 1), then the coordinate , coalesce(nullif(p.name, ''), nullif(p.name_en, ''), p.kind || ' ' || nullif(p.ref, ''), printf('osmdb coordinate (%.5f/%.5f)', p.lat, p.lon)) as display_name -- description, example: hospital, Heiligkreuz 25 (emergency room, helipad) , p.kind || coalesce(', ' || nullif(p.address, ''), '') || case when p.emergency_room and p.helipad_near then ' (emergency room, helipad)' when p.emergency_room then ' (emergency room)' when p.helipad_near then ' (helipad)' else '' end as display_desc from places p where p.lat between ?3 and ?4 and p.lon between ?5 and ?6 and instr(',' || ?9 || ',', ',' || p.kind || ',') > 0 and ( ?7 < 0 or mx_calc_distance(?1, ?2, p.lat, p.lon, 3440) between ?7 and ?8 ) {designer_filter} order by random() limit 1

stats_sqls.query: WITH act AS MATERIALIZED ( -- one row per takeoff/landing, with the previous activity row and the time of the previous landing SELECT line_id, activity, local_date_days * 86400.0 + local_time_sec AS t, lat, lon, IFNULL(lag(line_id) OVER w, 0) AS prev_act_line_id, max(CASE WHEN activity = 'landing' THEN local_date_days * 86400.0 + local_time_sec END) OVER (ORDER BY line_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prev_landing_t FROM stats WHERE activity IN ('takeoff', 'landing') WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY line_id) ), td AS MATERIALIZED ( -- v26.10.1 skip bounce landings: a "landing" less than 10 sec after the previous landing belongs to that landing SELECT line_id AS td_line_id, t AS td_t, lat AS td_lat, lon AS td_lon, prev_act_line_id, activity FROM act WHERE NOT (activity = 'landing' AND IFNULL(t - prev_landing_t, 999.0) <= 10.0) ), descent AS MATERIALIZED ( -- rows from the previous activity up to the touchdown, with the highest AGL (feet) still ahead of each row SELECT td.td_line_id, s.line_id, max(s.agl) OVER (PARTITION BY td.td_line_id ORDER BY s.line_id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) * 3.28084 AS max_agl_ft_ahead FROM td JOIN stats s ON s.line_id > td.prev_act_line_id AND s.line_id <= td.td_line_id WHERE td.activity = 'landing' ), steps(step_order, step_agl_ft) AS ( VALUES (1, 300.0), (2, 200.0), (3, 100.0), (4, 50.0), (5, 30.0), (6, 20.0), (7, 10.0), (8, 5.0) ), crossing AS ( -- final crossing of a step = first row after which the plane never climbs above it again SELECT d.td_line_id, st.step_order, st.step_agl_ft, min(d.line_id) AS row_line_id FROM descent d JOIN steps st ON d.max_agl_ft_ahead <= st.step_agl_ft GROUP BY d.td_line_id, st.step_order UNION ALL SELECT td_line_id, 99, 0.0, td_line_id FROM descent GROUP BY td_line_id -- the touchdown row ) SELECT x.td_line_id, x.step_order, x.step_agl_ft, CASE WHEN x.step_order = 99 THEN 'TD' ELSE printf('%d ft', x.step_agl_ft) END AS step_label, x.row_line_id, s.agl * 3.28084 AS agl_ft, s.airspeed AS ias_kt, s.groundspeed * 1.94384 AS gs_kt, s.vh_ind_fpm AS vs_fpm, s.pitch, s.roll, s.gforce_normal AS g, s.flap_ratio, td.td_t - (s.local_date_days * 86400.0 + s.local_time_sec) AS sec_to_td, mx_calc_distance(s.lat, s.lon, td.td_lat, td.td_lon, 6370880) AS dist_to_td_mt FROM crossing x JOIN td ON td.td_line_id = x.td_line_id JOIN stats s ON s.line_id = x.row_line_id ORDER BY x.td_line_id, x.step_order

WITH act AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT line_id, activity, local_date_days * 86400.0 + local_time_sec AS t, vh_ind_fpm, roll, pitch, groundspeed, m_total, IFNULL(lag(line_id) OVER w, 0) AS prev_act_line_id, max(CASE WHEN activity = 'landing' THEN local_date_days * 86400.0 + local_time_sec END) OVER (ORDER BY line_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prev_landing_t FROM stats WHERE activity IN ('takeoff', 'landing') WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY line_id) ), td AS MATERIALIZED ( -- v26.10.1 skip bounce landings (same rule as landing_height_steps) SELECT line_id AS td_line_id, t AS td_t, vh_ind_fpm AS td_fpm, roll AS td_bank, pitch AS td_pitch, groundspeed * 1.94384 AS td_gs_kt, m_total AS td_weight_kg, activity, prev_act_line_id FROM act WHERE NOT (activity = 'landing' AND IFNULL(t - prev_landing_t, 999.0) <= 10.0) ), final_rows AS MATERIALIZED ( -- airborne rows before the touchdown, with the highest AGL (feet) still ahead of each row SELECT td.td_line_id, s.vh_ind_fpm, s.roll, s.groundspeed * 1.94384 AS gs_kt, s.agl * 3.28084 AS agl_ft, max(s.agl) OVER (PARTITION BY td.td_line_id ORDER BY s.line_id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) * 3.28084 AS max_agl_ft_ahead FROM td JOIN stats s ON s.line_id > td.prev_act_line_id AND s.line_id < td.td_line_id WHERE td.activity = 'landing' ), final_sum AS ( -- the final descent below 300 ft SELECT td_line_id, max(CASE WHEN agl_ft >= 50.0 THEN abs(vh_ind_fpm) END) AS final_max_sink_fpm, -- 300 ft .. 50 ft max(CASE WHEN agl_ft >= 50.0 AND gs_kt > 20.0 THEN abs(vh_ind_fpm) / (gs_kt * 5.3) END) AS final_max_glide_ratio, -- 1.0 = 3 degree path max(abs(roll)) AS final_max_bank -- 300 ft .. touchdown FROM final_rows WHERE max_agl_ft_ahead <= 300.0 GROUP BY td_line_id ), pre_td AS ( -- last 2 sec airborne: G while the wings carry the weight SELECT td.td_line_id, avg(s.gforce_normal) AS pre_td_g FROM td JOIN stats s ON s.line_id > td.prev_act_line_id AND s.line_id < td.td_line_id AND s.onground_any = 0 AND td.td_t - (s.local_date_days * 86400.0 + s.local_time_sec) BETWEEN 0.0 AND 2.0 WHERE td.activity = 'landing' GROUP BY td.td_line_id ), impact AS ( -- first 0.25 sec after contact. The average filters the gear-spring spike, the peak is kept for display SELECT td.td_line_id, avg(s.gforce_normal) AS td_g_avg, max(s.gforce_normal) AS td_g_peak FROM td JOIN stats s ON s.line_id >= td.td_line_id AND (s.local_date_days * 86400.0 + s.local_time_sec) - td.td_t BETWEEN 0.0 AND 0.25 WHERE td.activity = 'landing' GROUP BY td.td_line_id ) SELECT td.td_line_id, abs(td.td_fpm) AS td_fpm, impact.td_g_avg, impact.td_g_peak, pre_td.pre_td_g, impact.td_g_avg - pre_td.pre_td_g AS td_gear_load, abs(td.td_bank) AS td_bank, td.td_pitch, td.td_gs_kt, td.td_weight_kg, final_sum.final_max_sink_fpm, final_sum.final_max_glide_ratio, final_sum.final_max_bank FROM td LEFT JOIN impact USING (td_line_id) LEFT JOIN pre_td USING (td_line_id) LEFT JOIN final_sum USING (td_line_id) WHERE td.activity = 'landing' ORDER BY td.td_line_id

WITH act AS MATERIALIZED ( -- takeoff/landing rows, with the time of the previous landing SELECT line_id, activity, local_date_days * 86400.0 + local_time_sec AS t, max(CASE WHEN activity = 'landing' THEN local_date_days * 86400.0 + local_time_sec END) OVER (ORDER BY line_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prev_landing_t FROM stats WHERE activity IN ('takeoff', 'landing') ), real_td AS MATERIALIZED ( -- real touchdowns: a "landing" less than 10 sec after the previous landing is a bounce of that landing SELECT line_id AS td_line_id, t AS td_t FROM act WHERE activity = 'landing' AND IFNULL(t - prev_landing_t, 999.0) > 10.0 -- not a bounce: no other landing in the previous 10 sec ), win AS MATERIALIZED ( -- first 10 sec after each real touchdown, split into on-ground / airborne islands (grp) SELECT r.td_line_id, s.line_id, s.onground_any, s.local_date_days * 86400.0 + s.local_time_sec AS t, s.agl * 3.28084 AS agl_ft, lead(s.onground_any) OVER (PARTITION BY r.td_line_id ORDER BY s.line_id) AS next_onground_any, lead(s.vh_ind_fpm) OVER (PARTITION BY r.td_line_id ORDER BY s.line_id) AS next_vs_fpm, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.td_line_id ORDER BY s.line_id) - row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.td_line_id, s.onground_any ORDER BY s.line_id) AS grp FROM real_td r JOIN stats s ON s.line_id >= r.td_line_id AND (s.local_date_days * 86400.0 + s.local_time_sec) - r.td_t BETWEEN 0.0 AND 10.0 ), air AS ( -- one row per airborne island SELECT td_line_id, grp, max(t) - min(t) AS air_sec, max(agl_ft) AS max_agl_ft, max(CASE WHEN next_onground_any = 1 THEN abs(next_vs_fpm) END) AS recontact_fpm -- NULL = no re-contact in the window (touch-and-go / go-around) FROM win WHERE onground_any = 0 GROUP BY td_line_id, grp ), bounce AS ( -- a bounce: back on the ground in the window, and not a gear flicker (at least 0.2 sec or 1 ft) SELECT * FROM air WHERE recontact_fpm IS NOT NULL AND (air_sec >= 0.2 OR max_agl_ft >= 1.0) ) SELECT r.td_line_id, count(b.grp) AS bounce_count, max(b.max_agl_ft) AS max_bounce_agl_ft, max(b.air_sec) AS max_bounce_sec, max(b.recontact_fpm) AS worst_recontact_fpm FROM real_td r LEFT JOIN bounce b USING (td_line_id) GROUP BY r.td_line_id ORDER BY r.td_line_id
